messages:
incident_bot: P1 alert — high websocket disconnects and 502/504s for tenant atlas-enterprise (AtlasCorp) via enterprise VPC gateway eu-west-1b. Spike ~380 rps. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/vpc-streaming

emma_oncall: Oncall here. Observed client errors and SDK reconnect loops. Gateway gw-euw1-b reporting upstream 502s to stream-service. Paging eng-runtime + eng-infra.

sanjay_ops: I see dedicated pool atls-pool-1 where AtlasCorp is pinned. One proxy host at 98% iowait, tcp retransmits rising. Suspect streaming proxy lock contention.

oleg_infra: Envoy logs show repeated upstream reset pattern `STREAM_SHARD_LOCK_TIMEOUT`. Adding metric stream_shard_lock_seconds. Recommend short-term: flip tenant to poll fallback and relocate traffic to atls-pool-3.

katie_cs: Pinged AtlasCorp SRE (tom_atlas). They can accept fallback but request 10m notice before the switch.

emma_oncall: Agreed mitigation plan:
- A) Notify customer 10m before fallback (katie)
- B) Migrate tenant to atls-pool-3 (sanjay)
- C) Restart top 2 proxy VMs after drain (oleg)
- D) Post-incident: instrument lock path + add per-tenant concurrency cap (eng-runtime)

katie_cs: Customer confirmed they can take fallback now (10m notice given). Proceeding to toggle.

sanjay_ops: Running migration:
```
redctl traffic shift --tenant atlas-enterprise --from-pool atls-pool-1 --to-pool atls-pool-3 --drain 120 --no-sticky
```

incident_bot: Migration initiated by sanjay_ops (job id job-20260422-33). ETA ~4m.

oleg_infra: Scheduling proxy restarts on gw-euw1-a02 and gw-euw1-b04 after migration. Using safe drain and 30s pause between reboots.

emma_oncall: Enabling per-tenant fallback for atlas-enterprise at gateway. Config pushed.

katie_cs: AtlasCorp confirms fallback active. Error rate down from ~16% to ~2.8%. Some client retry churn but application usable.

mia_support: Filing incident INC-20260422-ATLAS with P1 severity and customer SLA watchers.

sanjay_ops: Migration complete. Traffic now served from atls-pool-3. CPU and retransmits falling back toward baseline.

oleg_infra: Proxy restarts completed. stream_shard_lock_seconds metric reduced ~70% on restarted nodes. 504s decreased.

alex_runtime: Quick note from runtime: the KV cache lock path did not honor exponential backoff under heavy fanout. We'll add a soft lock wait cap and queue reject for overloaded tenants as a mid-term fix.

emma_oncall: Current status summary:
- Fallback enabled for atlas-enterprise
- Traffic migrated to atls-pool-3
- Proxy restarts done
- Error rate now ~0.4% (target <0.1%)

katie_cs: AtlasCorp asked about ETA for streaming restore. Recommend 90m soak then staged canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with rollback if errors >1% or latency >300ms.

sanjay_ops: I'll own canary rollout and set automated rollback thresholds in monitoring.

alex_runtime: Action items:
- implement lock instrumentation (oleg)
- tenant qps cap and better retry semantics (runtime)
- RCA meeting in 48h (mia)

incident_bot: Incident marked mitigated at 2123471900. Please complete post-incident review within 72h.

emma_oncall: Handoff to sanjay_ops for canary monitoring. If rollback happen, page eng-runtime immediately.

sanjay_ops: Acknowledged. Starting 5% canary in 30m. Will post updates.

mia_support: Captured runbook steps, commands used, timestamps, and customer comms. Drafting initial RCA.

katie_cs: Creating a private thread for exec-level comms with AtlasCorp. Will include timeline and impact figures.

oleg_infra: Added infra backlog items: shard-level lock instrumentation, per-tenant queue depth limits, and safer retries on gateway proxy.

emma_oncall: Closing active pager; moving to monitoring/soak. Thanks team :heart:

sanjay_ops: Canary started — 5% traffic. Telemetry stable for 10m. Will increment per plan.
